title: Why is the sky blue? (It's not the ocean)

hook.narration: Why is the sky blue? The famous answer: oceans.

visual.pose: skygawk (shield-eyes up at the azure dome)
visual.prop: sea band + azure sky + kinetic title (title IS the caption)

fact_sources: myth documented as misconception — Royal Observatory Greenwich, 'Why is the sky blue?'

scenes.narration: Blue sea below. Blue sky above. Seems obvious. It's wrong.

visual.prop: mirror-symmetry sky/sea shimmer → crack splits the symmetry

fact_sources: same RMG misconception line — the symmetry is the seduction

scenes.narration: The Sahara sits a thousand kilometers from any sea.

visual.pose: shield (hand shading eyes on dune crest)
visual.prop: full-frame dunes + brilliant azure sky, scarf whipping

fact_sources: inland skies equally blue = entailment of the mechanism (RMG: cause is the atmosphere, not the ocean)

visual.pose: present (open palm up at the dome)
visual.prop: same dune frame, sky saturates + 'SAME BLUE.' stamp

scenes.narration: So what actually paints it? Sunlight, hitting air.

visual.prop: white beam slams into a bright air slab, spark burst on impact

fact_sources: HyperPhysics: scattering of sunlight off atmospheric molecules gives the blue sky

scenes.narration: Air flings blue sideways, six times harder than red.

visual.prop: molecule ricochet: blue photon bounces wild, red drifts straight, 'BLUE ≈ 6×'

fact_sources: Rayleigh ∝ 1/λ⁴; (700/450)⁴ = 5.86 ≈ six (computed day-009; do NOT say ten)

scenes.narration: Every patch of sky becomes a tiny blue lamp.

visual.prop: sky dome fills with glowing lamp patches popping in sequence

fact_sources: scattered blue arrives from all directions — RMG/HyperPhysics mechanism restated as image

scenes.narration: Aim your eyes away from the sun — deepest blue.

visual.prop: two swatches: AWAY FROM SUN (saturated) vs TOWARD SUN (washed)

fact_sources: HyperPhysics blusky.html — sky more saturated further from the sun (Mie glare washes near-sun sky)

scenes.narration: That's the sky. Not a mirror — a lamp.

visual.prop: mirror shatters → glowing lamp icon remains, 'NOT A MIRROR' struck through

scenes.narration: And the ocean? Water eats red, keeps blue.

visual.prop: ocean cross-section: red photons sink + fade, blue keeps going deep

fact_sources: LoC Everyday Mysteries 'Why is the ocean blue?' + Siegel: water preferentially absorbs red; blue penetrates deepest and back-scatters

scenes.narration: Sky and sea never painted each other. They just matched.

visual.pose: relaxed (small smile, loop mirror of hook)
visual.prop: hook composition returns — sky lamp + sea glow independent; kinetic closer 'THEY JUST MATCHED.'

fact_sources: restatement + inversion of the RMG-documented myth — no new claim
